limitations: Scoped ABI1 tools-only catalog, selection and refresh; resources/prompts and full AUG-003 acceptance remain open.
Synthetic local packs are exercised through real official SDK stdio clients. No real ChatGPT app integration or model request is claimed.

Cancellation/deadline cases wrap real filesystem work; deadline testing delays a completed read, and unsupported-platform testing supplies a refused manifest platform. No kernel interruption or OS sandbox is claimed.
The immutable owner ceiling is local to one stdio process/connection; clientInfo is descriptive, not authenticated shared remote identity.

caseEvidence.success: catalog discovery advertises exact version, both schemas and no payload execution
caseEvidence.permission_denied: catalog selection rejects stale, wrong-version, duplicate and unapproved entries atomically
caseEvidence.cancelled: catalog cancellation after actual I/O preserves the committed snapshot and stops further reads
caseEvidence.deadline: catalog deadline around actual I/O preserves the committed snapshot
caseEvidence.unsupported_platform: catalog reports incompatible ABI and unsupported platform without starting payload

hosted.skipScope: 12 existing Windows-only tests; no new catalog fixture skipped
